name: Target man hub (bridge)
engine: Oyarzabal's layoff drags a defender out, and the stretched defence lets Yamal's passes through reach Olmo.
about: The bridge between the layoff engine and stretch and thread. Oyarzabal lays the ball off to Yamal (Lays it off) and, because he drops deep to do it, a centre-back follows him: a clean layoff leaves their defence stretched for the rest of the attack (Drops deep). The layoff engine's output, a layoff, becomes stretch and thread's input, a stretched defence: Yamal's pass through or cut-back then gets there on a half win (Threads it) and goes to Olmo in the gap (Runs the channels). Third man runs and Rehearsed layoff keep the layoffs coming.
decisions: The ball into Oyarzabal first, even at worse odds than the carry: a clean one stretches them for the whole attack.
After the layoff, the pass through or cut-back rather than the shot: against a stretched defence a half win still arrives.
Olmo stays out of the build-up so he can be the man in the gap.
